Nek'zali the Soulcoiler: [해제] Once the Essence Rend target reaches the edge of the room, dispel it with Purify. A Latent Cultist pool is left where it was removed.
[생존기] Soulcoil Rite goes off with every Phase 2 Invoke, so take a turn with Divine Hymn.
@m [참고] Spells being cast are interrupted the moment Invoke ends, so start the 5 sec channel Divine Hymn after Invoke ends.

Entombed Sentinels: [해제] Blighted Blood is a Magic effect, so dispel it right away with Purify.
[위치] The two groups are more than 40 yards apart, so Divine Hymn only reaches your own group within 40 yards. Use it next to your assigned group.
[광역 피해] While Contaminate hits the raid every 3 sec, top up several players with Prayer of Healing and Prayer of Mending.

Vashnik the Malignant: [해제] Dispelling Exploding Infection makes Caustic Explosion hit the raid, so do not clear them all at once with Mass Dispel. Stagger them one at a time with Purify.
@m [생존기] Line up a Divine Hymn or Apotheosis turn with Gloom Expulsion and Conflagrating Expulsion, which grow with each Imbibe.

The Lost Explorers: [해제] An Icebound Flames that slips past interrupts is a Magic effect, so dispel it with Purify.
[생존기] Line up Divine Hymn with the window when Frostfire Volley debuffs are being cleared.
[탱버] Put Guardian Spirit on the tank when First Mate Nama's Steady Strikes stacks get high.

Sszorak: [탱버] Put Guardian Spirit on the tank taking Ravage to raise their healing received by 60%.
[광역 피해] When Venomous Surge ends and the whole raid takes damage, top up with Prayer of Healing and Halo.
[위치] When gathering in the middle before the Howling Maelstrom gusts, drop Angelic Feather to speed up late players.

The Twin Fangs: [생존기] Line up Divine Hymn or Apotheosis with the 6 sec of raid damage from Stir the Depths.
@m [분담] Dump Flash Heal and Prayer of Mending on players inside a Tainted Blood source to fill the absorb within 8 sec.
@m [탱버] Put Guardian Spirit on the Ithraz tank stacking healing absorbs from Blood Torrent to raise their healing received by 60%.

The Coiled Altar: [생존기] Use Divine Hymn during the Suffocating Darkness and Defilement of the Coiled Altar healing absorb windows so its stacking healing received increase strips the absorbs.
@hm [생존기] Venom Rupture DoTs stack up right after Sever, so line up Apotheosis.
[위치] When spreading past 40 yards after soaking Guillotine, drop Angelic Feather for movement speed.

Ula'tek: [참고] Acidic Burst is a Poison, so Purify, which only removes Magic and Disease, cannot clear it. Leave poison dispels to another healer.
[생존기] Split Divine Hymn and Apotheosis between the 20 sec of Rage of the Shackled raid damage and Fury Unleashed.
@hm [생존기] Players turned to stone by Petrifying Sting absorb healing, so raise their healing received by 60% with Guardian Spirit.

Nymrissa Wavecaller: [생존기] Take a Divine Hymn turn on Unending Tides.
[광역 피해] After Pop! knocks the raid apart, top up with Halo, which reaches out to 40 yards, and Prayer of Mending.
@hm [생존기] If a missed Frost Orb stacks up the Shatter DoT, hold through it with Apotheosis.

Imperator Averzian: [생존기] On Dark Upheaval at the pull and after each intermission, heal the raid within 40 yards for 5 sec with Divine Hymn.
[탱버] When Gnashing Void DoTs stack on the tank picking up adds under Weakened, raise their healing received by 60% with Guardian Spirit.
@m [광역 피해] Heal through the 10 sec Lingering Darkness DoT on players dispelled of Void Marked with Renew and Flash Heal.

Vorasius: [해제] The Blisterburst damage taken increase and the Creep Spit slow are Magic effects, so dispel them with Purify. If several players at the wall have them, clear up to 5 players within 15 yards at once with Mass Dispel.
[광역 피해] After the raid takes Primordial Roar stacked, top up the target and 4 players within 40 yards together with Prayer of Healing.
@m [생존기] Line up Divine Hymn when the first Blistercreep pack pops.

Fallen-King Salhadaar: [생존기] Use Divine Hymn or Apotheosis on the 20 sec of raid damage from Entropic Unraveling.
[참고] Strip the Oppressive Darkness healing absorb from players coming out of Despotic Command with Flash Heal.
[탱버] Put Guardian Spirit on the tank taking Shattering Twilight by the wall.

Vaelgor & Ezzorak: [해제] Dread Breath fear is a Magic effect, so dispel it with Purify. If several players are caught in the cone, clear them at once with Mass Dispel.
[생존기] Part of the Midnight Flames damage gets through Radiant Barrier, so line up Divine Hymn.
[참고] Put Guardian Spirit on the tank gaining healing absorbs from Rakfang stacks to raise their healing received by 60%.

Lightblinded Vanguard: [해제] The Avenger's Shield DoT is a Magic effect, so dispel it right away with Purify.
@m [해제] On Mythic, when Avenger's Shield targets every player, clear the DoTs from up to 5 players within 15 yards at once with Mass Dispel.
[분담] Focus heal players with the Tyr's Wrath healing absorb using Prayer of Healing and Flash Heal.

Crown of the Cosmos: [해제] Corrupting Essence on a player is a Magic effect, so dispel it with Purify.
[해제] Purifying Null Corona moves the absorb to someone else, so heal through it with Flash Heal and only Purify in an emergency.
@nh [광역 피해] The Aspect of the End target's healing received keeps dropping, so raise it by 60% with Guardian Spirit.

Chimaerus the Undreamt God: [해제] Fearsome Cry fear that slips past interrupts is a Magic effect, so dispel it with Purify. If several players are affected, use Mass Dispel.
@hm [해제] Dispel Consuming Miasma with Purify once the target reaches an Alndust Essence pool.
[광역 피해] Strip the Rift Sickness healing absorb applied every time adds spawn from several players at once with Halo and Prayer of Healing.

Belo'ren, Child of Al'ar: [광역 피해] Heal off the Light Burn and Void Burn healing absorbs completely with Flash Heal and Prayer of Mending.
[생존기] Burning Heart comes more often during Phase 2 Rebirth, so line up Apotheosis or Divine Hymn.
[탱버] Put Guardian Spirit on the tank taking Light Edict or Void Edict.

Midnight Falls: [분담] Heal a Dusk Crystal to full with Flash Heal to turn it into a Dawn Crystal.
@nh [해제] The stacking Safeguard buff is a Magic effect, so strip it with Dispel Magic. If the matrices are grouped, strip several at once with Mass Dispel.
[광역 피해] During Total Eclipse, strip the Eclipsed healing absorbs with Halo and Prayer of Healing, prioritizing crystal carriers.

Rotmire: @hm [참고] The Poison Burst DoT is a Poison, so Purify cannot clear it. Leave poison dispels to another healer.
[생존기] Rotting Pustules makes damage ramp up as the fight goes on, so stack Divine Hymn and Apotheosis late in the fight.
[광역 피해] When Fungal Bloom knocks the raid apart, heal everyone within 40 yards at once with Halo.

note: There is no spec-specific source for each raid boss, so these are general principles written by matching ability tooltips to boss mechanics.

notes: Purify는 마법과 질병만 지워 Ula'tek 독 해제 불가
Holy Word 계열은 이름에 쌍점이 있어 문장에서 제외
1시즌: 해제 줄은 digest 해제 목록(Magic)과 Purify·Mass Dispel·Dispel Magic 툴팁을 짝지었다. Improved Purify는 질병만 더하므로 Poison Burst는 해제 불가로 적었다.
1시즌: 이름에 쌍점이 든 Holy Word 기술은 점검 규칙상 쓰지 않았다. 영웅 특성 전용 기술은 쓰지 않았다.
